result.markdown:
For a small support team, my top recommendation would be **Freshdesk** for an all-round help desk, or **Help Scout** if you primarily handle customer support through email and want something simple.

The best choice depends on whether you need basic ticket management, omnichannel support, automation, or a more sophisticated customer service operation.

Here are the five platforms I'd shortlist in 2026.

## Best help desk software compared

![Freshdesk Logo PNG Vector, Icon Free Download](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6qU8kcZ34jjxaMCtOBf7YWhzyOSb4fLSOT_GPJYQYIx24a7PwWoi7hpZo4x509_4b3-kIDLNQe_ItQQEi-WAvlGt3qon3gqgkkzkVJ7rlKkd7YLr912Nq6y7Vk1Uu5WARnpY3GOispDCTHWQEF5GWM56LXxTfHKwJYwpAR5GCS7-znnYRHScTTJZc1y6rm-b?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Freshdesk**

(Best overall)

From US\$19/agent/month

- Excellent ticket management.
- Automation, prioritisation and reporting.
- Knowledge base and self-service.
- Good balance between functionality and price.

Best for teams wanting a proper help desk that can grow with them.

[Freshdesk website](https://www.freshworks.com/freshdesk/)

---

![Help Scout Pricing & Reviews 2026 | Techjockey.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Vc4OfpksDG0SYFQO2E4DBpLJOQUw-u5-79PbQ0FAzOhtZzreG-oym8CqN3NjPdhGdB9thM6s19ul7-oCFNRzT3e41X5EcsNhFO6CSeSVnQFxwuN5lbEVYZwGfBuSEovHpvvj_dafp0K7DuHOnDsBXe2D-P9xjZT98_6jjWq8rmebpqXoOtAcpGFSu_5ylm1p?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Help Scout**

(Best for simplicity)

Free plan available; paid from US\$25/user/month

- Very intuitive interface.
- Shared inbox for the entire team.
- Customer history and internal notes.
- Knowledge base and saved replies.

Best for small teams that want to manage customer emails without unnecessary complexity.

[Help Scout website](https://www.helpscout.com/)

---

![Planning your knowledge base](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/c-aP08cOYxkyyv9X77vAO6BTznUrnbcE682O_PNXv85rTzeJ7P8rfPi0zwEy5RuJoItPtTqoOS_qx_th3WBRO5qW1_R1PEH6lnQv9fjQNK8k9Lq0ZpXaKAQ9c430TCrqKQIQ-l-YOuE_UJtZkcQj3vAw0fnqYwhILulvnKb-85lypWsGsBgNPmp7t1d2mt9a?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Zoho Desk**

(Best budget option)

Free for up to 3 agents; paid from US\$7/user/month

- Strong ticket management.
- Workflow automation.
- Reporting and analytics.
- Integrates with the wider Zoho ecosystem.

Best if keeping software costs low is a priority.

[Zoho Desk website](https://www.zoho.com/desk/)

---

![CXPA Global | CX Day](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Df7ZME9U6OBHF5y7Iy8re15rfxWfkij2J5upWOY6h17xPwPTHy9GzGMO1pjPycv2eahYGXuZJQqpk7Eu-n45330bnP145JuZvq23mLa9ySgQfmrjrLanGhUx6oyklDReusakKYD0C0EVNYz4WHwYHTEn8t4EiNn2pI71GHk_6Pu88F0xspYAogvoagE-Nhjq?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Zendesk**

From US\$19/agent/month for Support Team; Suite starts higher

- Powerful ticketing and routing.
- Extensive integrations.
- Advanced reporting and SLAs.
- Comprehensive customer support capabilities.

Best for teams expecting significant growth or more complex support requirements.

[Zendesk website](https://www.zendesk.com/)

---

![Free High-Quality Intercom Icon for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/2iS5ZLxIYok771vUvsweb4rXP-AA7f3vaN2nAUlz6rEPVuUMBtExpOQB8q7cu_pWcY4yC1n2TjiEYf6i36bbRfOMAFSo_inWjdMFW4sqbbtH6Ujr0vAthLnUtS23mtD3lu3sZKdPqVnNsBxQ3kmlWGWkpnB3wpHGc1UDv_EOxOvIw06oCcyXmy3vDSJ944kq?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Intercom**

From approximately US\$29/seat/month, plus AI usage charges

- Live chat and messaging.
- AI customer support agent.
- Automated customer conversations.
- In-app support and proactive messaging.

Best for SaaS businesses and teams handling lots of website or in-app enquiries.

[Intercom website](https://www.intercom.com/)

Pricing is indicative USD list pricing, generally with annual billing. Check current plan limits, add-ons and Australian pricing before purchasing.

## My recommendation

For a small support team, I'd narrow it down like this\:

| Your requirements | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| Best overall help desk | Freshdesk |
| Simple email support | Help Scout |
| Lowest cost | Zoho Desk |
| Complex workflows | Zendesk |
| AI and live chat | Intercom |
